Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus, as determined by the new American Diabetes Association guidelines, which include a fasting plasma glucose level greater than 126 mg/dl (7.0 mmol/l), or a 2-hour postload value in the oral glucose tolerance test of greater than 200 mg/dl, with confirmation by a retest
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has documented type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed at age 48 with metformin therapy, meeting ADA criteria for diagnosis

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: For participants aged 40 years or older, history of CVD (heart attack, stroke, history of coronary revascularization, history of peripheral or carotid revascularization, or demonstrated angina)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has documented history of recurrent myocardial infarctions, emergency stenting, and coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) at age 55

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: For participants aged 55 years or older, a history of CVD is not required, but participant must be considered to be at high risk for experiencing a CVD event due to existing CVD, subclinical disease, or 2+ CVD risk factors
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is 58 years old with established CVD (myocardial infarctions, CABG), familial hypercholesterolemia, 20 pack-year smoking history, and family history of sudden cardiac death

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: HbA1c 7.5%-9% (if on more drugs) or 7.5%-11% (if on fewer drugs)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's HbA1c is 6.5%-7.2% while on metformin (single drug), which falls below the required 7.5% threshold

Recap: Patient meets diabetes diagnosis and CVD risk criteria but fails HbA1c requirement. No exclusion criteria apply.
